name: agy-linux-live-update
description: Check and update the Linux Antigravity desktop App (/opt), agy CLI, and this plugin (from GitHub). Includes root install.sh for FHS installs.
suggestedPrompts: Check whether the Antigravity desktop App and agy CLI have updates using the agy-linux-live-update plugin scripts.
Update only the Antigravity desktop App in /opt using the agy-linux-live-update plugin (pkexec required).
Update only the agy CLI using the agy-linux-live-update plugin and the official install.sh.
